The reason for this behavior lies in the implementation of the `__setitem__` method in the `IndexingMixin` class. Specifically, when updating a categorical value, it creates a new category array instead of modifying the original one.

To fix this issue, we need to modify the implementation of the `__setitem__` method to update the original category array in-place.
